Flow.description: Runs on update. When SchoolMint + Guardian fields change (and we didn’t just stamp the lookups), launches async path to upsert guardian accounts and stamp guardian lookups on the Individual Application.
Flow.label: Individual Application (After Save) Upsert Guardians (Async - Update)

start.filterFormula:
OR(
AND( ISBLANK({!$Record.Primary_Guardian__c}),
OR( ISCHANGED({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_1_Email__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_1_Phone__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_1_First_Name__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_1_Last_Name__c}) ),
OR( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_1_Email__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_1_Phone__c})), AND( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_1_First_Name__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_1_Last_Name__c})) ) ) ),
AND( ISBLANK({!$Record.Secondary_Guardian__c}),
OR( ISCHANGED({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_2_Email__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_2_Phone__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_2_First_Name__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_2_Last_Name__c}) ),
OR( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_2_Email__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_2_Phone__c})), AND( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_2_First_Name__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!$Record.Parent_Guardian_2_Last_Name__c})) ) ) )
)
